add_definitions(-D__WINESRC__)
spec2def(dwmapi.dll dwmapi.spec)

# dwmapi.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dwmapi-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(dwmapi_shims OBJECT dwmapi_main.c)
target_link_libraries(dwmapi_shims PRIVATE uuid wine libuser32 libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(dwmapi_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(dwmapi dwmapi-cargo dwmapi.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dwmapi_shims psdk uuid_sources)
